about.title: About me
about.paragraph1: I'm Yamitselly Carrillo, a Software Development student interested in creating efficient technology solutions. I currently combine my academic training with self-taught learning to build solid projects that integrate backend logic and interactive frontend experiences.
about.paragraph2: My technical development stack includes Python, JavaScript and Java, backed by knowledge of relational database management with MySQL, MariaDB and SQLite, and Apache server configuration.
about.paragraph3: I also use design tools such as Figma and Canva to prototype intuitive interfaces, and I take advantage of Artificial Intelligence technologies to optimize my workflows, data analysis and code development.
